item.title: The Rijksmuseum's HSTS lasts 30 days.
item.description:
A Permissions-Policy, a Referrer-Policy, nosniff, and a sitemap named in robots.txt. But Strict-Transport-Security sets max-age to 30 days, and http:// reaches https through a temporary 307.
The lesson for every team: Raise HSTS max-age to at least a year, ideally two, and make the http redirect permanent with a 301.
One automated analysis of public pages on 19 Oct 2026. A starting point, not a verdict. How the review works, step by step: https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=rijksmuseum
#WebSecurity #HSTS #Museums #QA #QAlab

item.title: Lonely Planet's home is 1.8 MB of HTML.
item.description:
robots.txt blocks GPTBot from training but lets answer crawlers in, and sitemaps are listed. But every page analyzed ships over 500 KB of HTML, and the home page is 1.8 MB before compression, ahead of any image.
The lesson for every team: Move bulky inline data out of the HTML and load it when needed. Smaller documents parse and paint sooner.
One automated analysis of public pages on 19 Oct 2026. A starting point, not a verdict. How the review works, step by step: https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=lonelyplanet

item.title: CVE-2026-40217: LiteLLM — BerriAI LiteLLM Unprotected Alternate Channel Vulnerability
item.description:
BerriAI LiteLLM contains an unprotected alternate channel vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via bytecode rewriting at the /guardrails/test_custom_code URI.
Via CISA KEV, by BerriAI, 2026-11-18.
https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-40217

item.title: CVE-2026-90436: Axis — Apache Axis Unsafe Reflection Vulnerability
item.description:
Apache Axis contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via a crafted SOAP fault message that causes Axis to load and instantiate an attacker-specified class when a suitable class is available on the application classpath. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised…
Via CISA KEV, by Apache, 2026-11-18.
https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-90436

item.title: CVE-2026-90817: Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) — Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) Code Injection Vulnerability
item.description:
Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code on the server. An attacker could exploit this via crafted HTTP requests that access an unintended controller route from a public survey context and supply a crafted file-path or stream parameter during data import…
Via CISA KEV, by Vanderbilt University, 2026-11-18.
https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-90817

item.description:

The lesson for every team: Write a one-line description per page: what it teaches and for whom. Docs pages are where it pays most.

item.title: Cloudflare's CSP skips 5 of 20 pages.
item.description:
Organization JSON-LD, security.txt, a Permissions-Policy, and robots.txt that welcomes AI crawlers by name. But the home page's content security policy is missing on 5 of the 20 pages analyzed, like /galileo/.
The lesson for every team: Set security headers once at the edge or server, not per page template. Attackers look for the weakest page.

Takeaway: Send Strict-Transport-Security with a max-age of at least a year, so browsers never try plain http again.
One automated analysis of public pages on 20 Nov 2026, requested through QA-lab URL Review. A snapshot to start from, not a verdict. Report: https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review.html?live=u-artedentalmvd-com
Review your own site: https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review.html
